subject: Allow factors in ggvis plot to keep same colour

messages.author: 9e5a298f3356dbd4
messages.subject: Allow factors in ggvis plot to keep same colour
parts:
I've found ggvis to be a fantastic tool, but one of the problems I've encountered is when I use the factors in a column to dynamically add items from a checkbox, the colours of the different factors change as I add or remove them. Does anyone know of a way to set the colour for each factor?

    data %>% 
        ggvis(x = input_select(objects.to.plot, map = as.name, label = "X Axis"), 
              y = input_select(objects.to.plot, map = as.name, label = "Y Axis")) %>%
    
    layer_points(prop("fill", as.name(input_factor)), size := input_slider(10, 100, label = "Point Size"), 
                     opacity := input_slider(0, 1, label = "Opacity")) %>%

    scale_ordinal("stroke", range = c("red", "green", "blue"))

The last line of code I found from this question, but it still doesn't tie a colour to a specific variable - it changes as I manipulate the text boxes.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Allow factors in ggvis plot to keep same colour
parts:
